name: Incorrect Mobile Number Format
goal: User tries to update mobile number with an invalid format.
constraints: Bot should reject invalid mobile number and prompt for correct format.

phases.description: User says 'Mera mobile number update karna hai'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for new mobile number.
Bot detects invalid format and asks for a valid 10-digit mobile number.
Bot confirms mobile number updated successfully.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
